source: Independent, source-informed endpoint configuration, CRC32C, hash-stream validation, URL signing, save orchestration, upload-stream lifecycle and multipart request orchestration in the seven components listed below. Remaining SDK runtime and declarations retain upstream code with VPM imports, structural platform types and focused corrections. Original licenses and contracts remain attributed; this is a partial rewrite.
scope: Actual VentiMath backend save, signing, listing, exists and delete paths; local file uploads and bucket creation; selected upstream signing, checksum and helper tests. Other upstream APIs remain available but are not all independently verified.

implementation.kind: mixed: independent endpoint configuration, checksums, URL signing and save/upload-stream/multipart orchestration with retained SDK transport/operations
implementation.basis: Endpoint selection, CRC32C, hash-stream validation V2/V4 URL signing and File.save, createWriteStream and multipart orchestration are independently implemented. Bucket/file operations, transport and signed POST policies still retain upstream code with focused corrections.
implementation.targetScope: Bucket/file metadata, save/upload, existence, deletion, listing and signing paths used by VentiMath and Firebase Admin.
implementation.remainingWork: Independently implement the remaining bucket/file operations, resumable upload, authenticated request dispatch and download transport, existence, deletion, listing and signed POST policies used by callers, retaining existing correctness fixes and wire contracts.

independentComponents.lib/storage-endpoint.js: Own per-client endpoint selection, HTTP(S) validation and normalization, explicit-over-ambient precedence and captured emulator identity. Metadata and upload hosts cannot diverge when an explicit API endpoint overrides an ambient emulator. Canonical default endpoints keep normal authentication; V4 form routes use the captured client identity rather than reading global state later.
independentComponents.lib/crc32c.js: Own slicing-by-eight Castagnoli checksum engine with derived private tables, signed/unsigned 32-bit seed normalization, bounded numeric initialization, chunked/resumed updates and async file streaming. Public inspection tables cannot change active computations; byte-view offsets and upstream base64 decoding remain supported.
independentComponents.lib/hash-stream-validator.js: Own Transform with native private state, non-destructive MD5 snapshots, final digest caching, hashing before chunk emission and independent validation of every enabled checksum. Custom CRC providers and stream backpressure remain supported.
independentComponents.lib/signer.js: Own V2/V4 URL signing with per-operation destination/resource/auth snapshots, synchronous input validation, canonical headers/query encoding, exact payload hashes and preserved signing errors. Mutating caller URL/bucket values or replacing signer.auth cannot change the captured destination or provider across credential awaits; query accessors are read once.
independentComponents.lib/save.js: Own save orchestration, captured plain options and byte payloads, per-attempt retry configuration and stream completion. One-shot streams are not retried; replayable factories and conditional writes keep their retry budget. Invalid contexts settle once and never start an upload. Multipart orchestration is independently implemented in simple-upload.js; authenticated dispatch and resumable protocol remain retained.
independentComponents.lib/upload-stream.js: Own lazy upload setup, owned options and per-attempt retry policy, gzip/checksum pipeline, backpressure, response metadata gate and cancellation. Frozen input records work, cancellation during MIME lookup cannot resurrect transport, and closure without metadata rejects instead of hanging. Multipart orchestration is independently implemented; authenticated dispatch and resumable protocol remain retained.
independentComponents.lib/simple-upload.js: Own one-shot multipart request planning, metadata serialization, progress stream, cancellation signal and guarded response settlement. Captured queries preserve precondition/ACL/billing precedence; late or duplicate callbacks cannot overwrite metadata after cancellation/completion. Abort signals prevent HTTP startup after pending authentication resolves. VPM teeny-request owns framing and HTTP; SDK authentication/interceptor dispatch and resumable protocol remain retained.

changes: VPM-specific emulatorHost is an optional per-client endpoint, mutually exclusive with apiEndpoint. Ambient STORAGE_EMULATOR_HOST remains supported when neither explicit option is set; construction does not mutate it.

Explicit apiEndpoint selects both metadata and upload hosts. Canonical default endpoints keep authentication rather than being classified as custom by casing or trailing slash. Endpoints reject non-HTTP schemes, credentials, query strings and fragments.
Storage captures emulatorHost as a read-only property. Signed V4 form routing uses this per-client context; later environment changes cannot add or remove the bucket route.

CRC32C computes checksums independently using private derived tables. Valid unsigned seeds normalize to the signed representation before serialization; out-of-range seeds fail at construction. Mutating exported inspection tables cannot corrupt results.

Hash-stream digest reads no longer finalize the live MD5. Every enabled checksum must have a matching expected value unless updateHashesOnly is set; successful MD5 cannot conceal a CRC mismatch. Bytes are hashed before downstream consumers can mutate them.

URLSigner independently implements V2/V4 signing and canonicalization. Captured URLs, bucket/file names, dates, queries, signing endpoints and authentication providers stay consistent across asynchronous credentials/signing. Existing reserved-field, canonical-header and exact-SHA256 fixes are preserved.

File.save owns its retry settings and upload inputs. A non-idempotent upload cannot disable retries on concurrent conditional writes; metadata and Buffer/Uint8Array payload mutations cannot change the captured upload. Context validation cannot double-call a callback or start an invalid upload. Non-retryable uploads skip unnecessary retry machinery.

File.createWriteStream owns setup and completion without mutating supplied options. Cancellation removes metadata/forwarding listeners and settles pending writes once; missing response metadata on transport close is ERR_STREAM_PREMATURE_CLOSE. Existing checksum/deletion failure contracts are preserved.

Multipart uploads propagate cancellation across pending authentication, do not emit successful metadata events after cancellation, and settle duplicate callbacks once. Request options are owned; per-attempt maxRetries remains zero, leaving replay to File.save.

The unused retained makeWritableStream and ProgressStream implementation and internal declarations are removed. Cancellation with no supplied error signals null to the owned HTTP adapter, avoiding an unused default DOMException stack; supplied errors retain their identity.

verification.endpointContext: Original/VPM controls under scripts/firebase-admin-conformance/storage-context.cjs use two local servers, metadata/upload/download requests, V2/V4 URLs, independently verified V4 form signatures, explicit-versus-ambient configuration and canonical default authentication classification on Node 24 and Bun.
verification.retainedScope: 110 retained signing/checksum/helper tests, existing focused tests, 25-request HTTP scenarios, Firebase callers and packed type consumers remain verified. This does not establish an independent implementation of the remaining SDK.
verification.crc32c: Original/VPM isolated controls compare 260 lengths, five chunkings, resumed seeds and files with an independent bit-at-a-time oracle; demonstrate upstream table-mutation and numeric-seed failures; preserve base64 compatibility and cross-realm/sliced byte views on Node 24 and Bun.
verification.hashStream: Six focused groups compare original/VPM normal streams, reproduce early-finalization/CRC-masking/downstream-mutation faults, and exercise empty input, custom providers, failure identity and real backpressure pipelines on Node 24 and Bun.
verification.urlSigner: Existing 110-test suites and signing regressions retained, plus five focused groups demonstrating original mutable-destination/provider faults, single-read query validation, frozen Date/configuration handling and independent RSA verification of app-used V2/V4 download paths.
verification.save: Seven focused groups reproduce original shared-policy, mutable-payload and duplicate-callback faults, preserve source factories/progress/retries and reject premature close. An original/VPM HTTP concurrency control verifies that a conditional upload retries after 503 while a non-idempotent upload is active. Existing 25-request caller scenarios remain covered on Node 24 and Bun.
verification.uploadStream: Eight focused original/VPM groups on Node 24 and Bun: frozen inputs, cancellation across MIME awaits, missing/late metadata, gzip/auto MIME, checksum and partial/resumed uploads, corruption cleanup errors, retry/metadata ownership, slow-sink backpressure and empty uploads. Existing 25-request HTTP suite and save concurrency controls pass.
verification.multipart: Five focused original/VPM groups plus live HTTP controls on Node24/Bun verify query precedence, binary/progress data, frozen options, errors, duplicate/late settlement, auth/encryption/interceptors and cancellation. Original opens one HTTP upload after auth resolves despite cancellation; VPM opens none. Existing 25-request callers and concurrent-save controls pass.
